subject.label: sport
subject.note: School of Sport container context: a single academic school spanning several sport subjects (sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, strength & conditioning). There is no QAA subject benchmark for sport in this repo, so the prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark file. subject.scheme, subject.code and subject.benchmarkId are therefore empty and context.label is "sport" so {{context}} tokens resolve to "sport".

_note: School of Sport container context pack for revising-exams-advanced. It frames active revision and exam performance for the school AS A WHOLE, drawing worked examples from across its subjects and varying the subject lesson to lesson (L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching and physical education, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation), rather than from one discipline.
